stories.headline: Marvell shares jump 32% after Jensen Huang calls it the 'next trillion-dollar company' at Computex

key_facts.fact: Marvell shares closed up 32.52% on Tuesday June 2 after Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's Computex 2026 remarks; intraday gain pushed market cap to about $234B and added more than $45B in market value.
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang hailed Marvell Technology as the next trillion-dollar firm, sending its shares up 32.52% on Tuesday.

key_facts.fact: Huang joined Marvell CEO Matt Murphy for a roughly 10-minute on-stage segment during Murphy's Computex 2026 keynote in Taipei on June 2.
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang made a surprise guest appearance during Marvell Technology CEO Matt Murphy's keynote at Computex 2026 in Taipei on June 2, joining Murphy on stage for about 10 minutes.

key_facts.fact: Marvell's networking and connectivity chips are critical for AI data centers where computing tasks are distributed across thousands of chips that must share data quickly, Huang said.
key_facts.excerpt: 'When you take a computing problem, and you disaggregate it into a lot of parts, and you distribute it across the entire data center, what's necessary is connectivity,' Huang said.

key_facts.fact: Nvidia committed a $2B investment in Marvell earlier this year, part of a broader push into photonics and co-packaged optics partners.
key_facts.excerpt: Nvidia recently committed to a $2 billion investment into Marvell. Nvidia is also investing billions into other firms developing photonics technology.

key_facts.fact: Murphy unveiled Marvell's new T100 Ethernet Switch for AI data centers and pitched co-packaged optics (CPO) as the only path to keep scaling bandwidth while cutting power.
key_facts.excerpt: Murphy presented Marvell's latest optical module and announced the new T100 Ethernet Switch, which is specifically designed for AI data centers and features the industry's lowest power consumption.

key_facts.fact: Marvell forecasts custom AI chip business to top $10B in annual revenue by fiscal 2029.
key_facts.excerpt: Marvell last week forecast that its custom chips business would surpass $10 billion in revenue in fiscal 2029, as cloud companies expand AI data centers.

stories.headline: Microsoft unveils Majorana 2 topological quantum chip built with AI, eyes commercial quantum machines by 2029

key_facts.fact: Microsoft announced Majorana 2, a next-generation topological quantum chip, at Microsoft Build on June 2, saying it expects commercial quantum systems by 2029.
key_facts.excerpt: Microsoft on Tuesday unveiled a new quantum computing chip that it redesigned with the help of AI ... will have systems by 2029.

key_facts.fact: Microsoft used its Discovery agentic AI platform to help design the new material stack behind Majorana 2.
key_facts.excerpt: Tweet by @microsoft: Announced today at #MSBuild: Microsoft unveiled Majorana 2, a next-generation topological quantum chip developed with the help of Microsoft Discovery's agentic AI.

key_facts.fact: CEO Satya Nadella said Majorana 1 proved the topological approach physics; Majorana 2 is where the company begins engineering at scale.
key_facts.excerpt: Tweet by @satyanadella: Majorana 1 proved out the physics of the topological approach, but Majorana 2 is where we start engineering at scale.

key_facts.fact: Microsoft says the new material stack promises useful quantum computing much sooner than prior roadmaps suggested.
key_facts.excerpt: Microsoft's Majorana 2 chip uses a new material stack that promises quantum computing much sooner.

stories.headline: Microsoft unveils Surface RTX Spark Dev Box with Nvidia Arm-based RTX Spark and 128GB unified memory

key_facts.fact: Microsoft unveiled the Surface RTX Spark Dev Box at Microsoft Build on June 2 — a local-first AI development machine powered by Nvidia's Arm-based RTX Spark with 128GB unified memory and a 100W thermal envelope.
key_facts.excerpt: The Surface RTX Spark Dev Box is designed for local-first AI development.

key_facts.fact: The device is configured and shipped with preinstalled developer tools, presented as turnkey for AI engineers.
key_facts.excerpt: Tweet by @pavandavuluri: Meet the new Surface RTX Spark Dev Box. All the power developers need, right out of the box.

key_facts.fact: Morgan Stanley's checks with PC brands at Computex pegged Nvidia N1X-based AI PC pricing at about US$2,899 for top models, with N1 models lower, per industry leaks circulating during Build week.
key_facts.excerpt: Tweet by @mweinbach: Morgan Stanley posted a report on RTX Spark and mentioned pricing: 'Our checks with PC brands at this year's Computex suggest AI PCs with N1X will need to price at US$2,899.

key_facts.fact: Microsoft positioned the Spark Dev Box alongside a broader developer-optimized Windows push: Linux-style Coreutils for Windows, WSL native containers, and an Intelligent Terminal.
key_facts.excerpt: Microsoft has created Coreutils for Windows from the uutils open-source project, and is launching new WSL containers.

stories.headline: ZutaCore raises $100M Series C at ~$600M valuation for direct-to-chip AI data center cooling

key_facts.fact: Israeli direct-to-chip liquid cooling startup ZutaCore closed a $100M Series C led by Mitsubishi Electric, Carrier and Samsung Ventures, announced on June 2.
key_facts.excerpt: Israeli company ZutaCore... has announced the completion of a $100 million Series C funding round. The round was led by global industrial and technology groups Mitsubishi Electric, Carrier, and Samsung Electronics, through its investment arm Samsung Ventures.

key_facts.fact: The round values ZutaCore at about $600M and brings total funding to roughly $200M since founding, per Calcalist.
key_facts.excerpt: ZutaCore is currently valued at close to $600 million, according to Calcalist estimates... The latest financing brings ZutaCore's total funding since its founding to approximately $200 million.

key_facts.fact: ZutaCore says its waterless two-phase cooling has been deployed at over 75 sites in North America, Europe and Asia, with partnerships across semiconductor and computing firms.
key_facts.excerpt: The company says its technology has already been deployed at more than 75 sites across North America, Europe, and Asia. It also maintains partnerships with major semiconductor and computing companies.

key_facts.fact: Capital will go to scaling commercial sales and expanding capacity to meet AI/HPC infrastructure demand.
key_facts.excerpt: The capital will be used to accelerate the company's global commercialization efforts, expand its sales network, and meet rapidly growing demand for AI and high-performance computing (HPC) infrastructure.

sources.title: Israeli AI cooling startup ZutaCore raises $100 million Series C at estimated $600 million valuation

stories.headline: SoftBank in early talks to anchor $800M Agile Robots round as humanoid race goes capital-intensive

key_facts.fact: SoftBank is in early discussions to anchor an $800M round for Munich-based Agile Robots, Bloomberg reported June 2.
key_facts.excerpt: SoftBank is in early discussions to anchor an $800 million funding round for Agile Robots, the Munich-headquartered robotics startup with significant operations in China, according to Bloomberg.

key_facts.fact: If completed, the round would put Agile Robots in the same capital tier as the best-funded humanoid and physical-AI peers; SoftBank's Vision Fund 2 previously led Agile's $220M Series C in 2021.
key_facts.excerpt: The potential deal would rank among the largest single raises in physical AI hardware... the Vision Fund 2 previously led a $220 million Series C in 2021.

key_facts.fact: The talks fit SoftBank's broader robotics pivot: a $5.375B acquisition of ABB Robotics (Oct 2025) and plans for a standalone AI/robotics company called Roze targeting a $100B valuation.
key_facts.excerpt: SoftBank executes a sweeping pivot toward robotics, including a $5.375 billion acquisition of ABB Robotics and plans for a standalone AI and robotics company called Roze targeting a $100 billion valuation.

key_facts.fact: SoftBank tapped Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan, Mizuho and Morgan Stanley on May 26 to prep a US IPO for Roze.
key_facts.excerpt: reported on May 26 that SoftBank had tapped Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan, Mizuho, and Morgan Stanley to prepare a US IPO for Roze.

stories.headline: French startup Quobly raises €115M Series A to commercialize silicon spin-qubit quantum computers

key_facts.fact: Grenoble-based Quobly raised €115M (~$150M) Series A led by STMicroelectronics, Bpifrance, SEALSQ and Isalt to commercialize silicon spin-qubit quantum computers.
key_facts.excerpt: French quantum computing startup Quobly SAS today announced that it has raised €130 million, or about $150 million, to commercialize its technology. The Series A round was led by publicly traded chipmaker STMicroelectronics NV, Bpifrance, SEALSQ and Isalt.

key_facts.fact: Additional participation from the European Innovation Council, Blast, Air Liquide Venture Capital and existing investor Innovacom; existing shareholders include CEA, CNRS, Quantonation, Supernova Invest.
key_facts.excerpt: The round was led by Bpifrance, SEALSQ, and STMicroelectronics, with participation from the European Innovation Council (EIC), Blast, Air Liquide Venture Capital (ALIAD), and existing investor Innovacom. Existing shareholders also include CEA, CNRS, Quantonation, Supernova Invest.

key_facts.fact: Quobly plans to ship its first commercial quantum computer by the end of 2026, partner with STMicro on a 100-qubit upgrade in 2027, and target a million-qubit system by 2032.
key_facts.excerpt: Quobly expects to ship its first commercial quantum computer by the end of 2026. Next year, it will work with STMicroelectronics to develop an upgraded version of the system with 100 qubits. The company hopes to build a quantum computer with a million qubits by 2032.

key_facts.fact: CEO Maud Vinet framed the round as moving from technology validation to industrial execution.
key_facts.excerpt: 'This financing marks a transition from technology validation to industrial execution,' said Quobly co-founder and Chief Executive Officer Maud Vinet.

sources.title: Quobly raises $150M for its silicon spin qubit technology

stories.headline: Vingroup commits $12.75M to Vinmotion USA humanoid robotics R&D arm

key_facts.fact: Vingroup's board approved a $12.75M investment in Vinmotion USA, Inc., a humanoid robot and AI research subsidiary, with the resolution dated May 29 and disclosure on June 2.
key_facts.excerpt: Vingroup has approved a $12.75 million investment in a US-based humanoid robot and AI technology research company... On May 29, the group's board of directors issued a resolution approving the acquisition of shares in Vinmotion USA, Inc.

key_facts.fact: Plans include building a US R&D center to attract global talent and partner with universities, research institutes and tech firms.
key_facts.excerpt: the company will research and develop humanoid robotic products and technology solutions. It also plans to establish a research and development centre in the US to attract global talents and collaborate with universities, research institutions, and leading advanced technology partners worldwide.

key_facts.fact: Vinmotion USA is being acquired from VinMotion General Purpose Humanoid Robots Application, Development and Research JSC, a Vingroup subsidiary spun up to focus on general-purpose humanoid robots.
key_facts.excerpt: The group's board of directors issued a resolution approving the acquisition of shares in Vinmotion USA, Inc. from VinMotion General Purpose Humanoid Robots Application, Development and Research JSC, a Vingroup subsidiary.
